title: Credited
player_goal: Buy (or decide not to buy) your first scooter.
design_goal: Reveal #11: the scooter + fuel gauge (ADR-06). The first salary as a reward; EMI as the first standing cost.

cast.role: Second-hand scooter ₹38,000 (floor ₹35,000, slick); EMI ₹6,000 + ₹3,200 × 10 on salary days → scooter_owned
Full tank ₹350 / ₹100 worth; the fuel gauge shows on his forecourt

beats.what: The salary lands (₹42,000, ADR-122) - 'Salary credited' and the tutorial toast: a two-wheeler gets you to work and nearby areas fast - mind the fuel. From now on a salary lands every 30 nights.
Sameer's chat: second-hand, ITPL Main Road, ask for Noor, don't pay sticker. The 500-D from the Whitefield street's second bay drops you by the shelter.

Noor: the grey scooter, ₹38,000. Outright is a slick haggle (compare the online listing, cash today, the dent; never lowball) that lands near ₹35,000–36,000. EMI is ₹6,000 down and ten instalments on salary days - a standing cost.
Keys, four litres in the tank. The bunk next door: full tank ₹350 or ₹100 worth. The fuel gauge appears while you stand on the forecourt.
Maps → any visited Whitefield pocket → RIDE · FUEL -N%: the ride card says Scooter → … with the fuel line; the gauge shows for a moment on landing; your scooter stands parked where you arrive.
Salary days: the EMI leaves through the ledger ('Noor Motors EMI'); a short wallet bounces it with stress. Ten paid → scooter_paid_off.

acceptance: the first salary toasts the two-wheeler tutorial and resets the countdown to 30 nights
the Whitefield street's second bay buses you to the showroom; arrival sets showroom_arrived
Noor's outright haggle lands at ₹35,000-36,000 with compare + reasons and refuses a lowball; EMI spends ₹6,000 and starts emi_left = 10
both deals set scooter_owned and put four litres (30%) in the tank; the grey scooter appears parked at the showroom, the street and the hill
standing on the bunk forecourt shows the fuel gauge; the attendant fills ₹350 → 100% or ₹100 → +30%
Maps offers RIDE · FUEL -N% to visited pockets once owned; the ride spends fuel and game minutes, the card shows the fuel line, the gauge shows on landing
a salary day spends ₹3,200 as 'Noor Motors EMI'; a short wallet bounces it; ten paid → scooter_paid_off
